title: Persist Callaway Chart Editor edits as the localStorage defaults

requirements.text: When a user saves changes in the Callaway Chart Editor, persist the saved 9-hole and 18-hole grid charts as the new *default* chart values in localStorage, so that future loads and “Reset to Defaults” use those saved values instead of the hard-coded code defaults.

quotes: take the edits I made in the Calloway Chart Editor and make them the default values stored localstorage

acceptanceCriteria: After clicking “Save Changes” in the Callaway Chart Editor for 9 holes, reloading the page shows the saved 9-hole chart values without requiring any additional action.
After clicking “Save Changes” in the Callaway Chart Editor for 18 holes, reloading the page shows the saved 18-hole chart values without requiring any additional action.
Clicking “Reset to Defaults” restores the chart to the latest saved defaults (from localStorage), not necessarily the original hard-coded defaults.

If the app is opened in a browser where no chart defaults exist in localStorage yet, the app initializes the localStorage defaults from the current hard-coded defaults and behaves the same as today (no user-visible regression).

requirements.text: Update the Callaway chart persistence layer to support separate localStorage keys for (a) user-default grid charts and (b) the currently-active/edited grid charts, and update the runtime chart selection logic to fall back to the localStorage defaults before falling back to hard-coded defaults.

quotes: make them the default values stored localstorage

acceptanceCriteria: A new pair of localStorage entries exists for storing the user-default grid charts for both 9 and 18 holes (distinct from the existing active/edited grid chart keys).
`getActiveGridChart(9|18)` resolves charts in this order: active/edited grid chart (if present and valid) → user-default grid chart (if present and valid) → hard-coded default grid chart.
If any stored chart JSON is invalid, it is ignored and cleared (preserving the current validation behavior).

constraints: Frontend immutablePaths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Do not change the Motoko backend canister logic or its stored data model.
Do not introduce third-party storage or any server-side persistence for the Callaway chart defaults (localStorage only).
Do not redesign the Callaway Chart Editor UI beyond what is necessary to support the new default-persistence behavior.
